content: Tada sarvavarana malapetasya jnanasya anantyaj jneyam alpam. (Then, when all veils of ignorance are removed, the infinite ocean of wisdom reveals that the knowable world is minute).
author: Patanjali
explanation:
In the profound psychology of the Yoga Sutras, Patanjali outlines the systematic roadmap for stilling mental fluctuations into radiant, sovereign stillness.

This teaching (Tada sarvavarana malapetasya jnanasya anantyaj jneyam alpam....) focuses directly on tada and sarvavarana. When we clear away reactive illusions and anchor ourselves in timeless principles, the mind recovers its pristine clarity and inner resilience.

True realization is never an abstract intellectual debate—it is an active discipline lived through quiet integrity and conscious presence in everyday moments.
practicalInsight: Apply this teaching on tada today: take a deliberate pause before reacting, align your actions with quiet integrity, and refuse to let transient friction disturb your center.
reflectionPrompt: How can you embody deeper tada and sarvavarana in the primary challenge you are navigating right now?
